name: external-svg-collection-policy
purpose: Defines allowed official open-source SVG sources, pinned commits, path allowlists, collection limits, provenance fields, and license handling for actually storing external SVG files.

reader_guide.summary: This policy is the source of truth for actual external SVG collection. It records which repositories may be downloaded, which paths are allowed, how many SVGs are collected, and which license files must be preserved.
how_to_read: Start with structure_rules to understand legal and path boundaries.
Read useful_keyword_priority to see how the collector prefers practical icons before filling alphabetically.
Read sources to see repository, pinned commit, allowed paths, license, and collection limits.
Run scripts/collect_external_svg_assets.py after changing this policy.
Run check-config-contract and design-asset-library tests after collection.
update_triggers: A new external SVG source is added.
A source commit, branch, license, path allowlist, or collection limit changes.
The external asset registry is regenerated.
A license or attribution rule changes.

structure_rules.rule: Each source must use a pinned commit archive URL, not a moving branch archive URL.
structure_rules.reason: Actual stored assets need reproducible source provenance.

structure_rules.rule: Each source must copy the upstream LICENSE into the source collection folder and record license metadata in external-asset-registry.json.
structure_rules.reason: Stored external assets need attribution and license traceability.

structure_rules.rule: Only SVG files under configured allowed_svg_roots may be stored; docs, preview art, brand logos, build output, and unrelated SVGs are excluded.
structure_rules.reason: Repository archives often include non-icon SVGs that should not become reusable assets accidentally.

structure_rules.rule: The first actual collection is bounded by max_assets per source and can be expanded by changing the policy and regenerating the registry.
structure_rules.reason: The user asked for many actual assets, but repo size and future maintainability still need controlled expansion.

field_guide.meaning: Priority terms used by the collector to pull generally useful UI, presentation, workflow, status, data, and developer icons before generic alphabetical fill.
Pinned GitHub codeload tarball URL used for deterministic collection.
Path roots inside the repository archive that may be copied as SVG assets.
Maximum number of SVG files to copy from the source in this tranche.
License label recorded for the collection; confirm again before public redistribution.
